data.name: Khadeejah
data.long_meaning: Khadeejah is the name of the first wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was a successful businesswoman and the most righteous woman of her time. The name is derived from the Arabic word khadaja, which means 'to offer' or 'to sell'. Khadeejah is an embodiment of excellence and success, and her name signifies the qualities of being righteous, strong, and wise.
